culpritSource.quote: Conan set up a trap, allowing him to reveal to Kogoro, Ran, and the local inspectors that the culprit is Taro Hayashi. Hayashi had given himself away when he had mentioned that the file that was missing in the camera was a video when no had told him so. When meant the only ones who knew this are Conan, Kogoro, Ran, the police, and the culprit himself.

summary.en:
Location: Toyama Bay

Victim: Satoru Aoki

Age: 52 years old

suspects: Chuji Ishiguro, Yosuke Akagi, and Kazushi Shirakawa
